# Flashfire

> Flashfire is an AI-powered job search automation service. We apply to 1000+ jobs on your behalf with role-tailored, ATS-optimized resumes, optimize your LinkedIn profile, and keep you updated in real time, so you can focus on interviews. Serving job seekers in the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands and France.

- [Home](https://www.flashfirejobs.com/): Overview of the Flashfire job search automation service

- [Book a demo](https://www.flashfirejobs.com/book-a-demo): Schedule a call with the team
